## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Identify affected entry points: Pi native memory, separate chat, standalone application or SDK.

## Validation

List relevant commands/results and link CI evidence. For documentation-only changes, explain which descriptions were checked against code. Keep real-provider experiments separate from deterministic tests.

## Compatibility and limits

Describe storage/schema, host-version or distribution implications. State material limitations or incomplete qualification. Omit this section when none apply.
